theme_and_archetype.description: A cinematic, moody, and highly professional dark interface inspired by Apple, Linear, and Arc. It blends Swiss minimalism with high-end glassmorphism. It strictly avoids purple/violet and relies on deep obsidian/zinc tones, striking white typography, and electric azure blue accents for interaction.
core_principles: Absolute Linear Simplicity: No clutter, everything is meticulously aligned.
High-End Glassmorphism: Surfaces must feel like milled crystal, not muddy gray.
Fluid Motion: Every interaction has a subtle, premium framer-motion transition.
Contrast over Color: Hierarchy is established through stark white against deep zinc, using accent color extremely sparingly.

rules: Use tight letter spacing (tracking-tight) for all headings.
Uppercase with wide spacing (tracking-[0.2em]) for overlines and small labels.
Maintain a 2-step tailwind size gap max between headings and subheadings.

headings.usage: Hero titles, section headers, dashboard widget numbers.

mono.usage: Data points in Creative Passport, timestamps, code/log snippets.

layout_and_spacing.spacing_system: Generous spacing. p-6, p-8, p-12 for containers. gap-8 for bento grids.
layout_and_spacing.dashboard_grid: Mode B: 'Control Room' Grid. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4. gap-6.
layout_and_spacing.marketing_grid: Mode A: 'Tetris' Grid. Asymmetric. col-span-8 row-span-2 for heroes.

surfaces.cards: bg-zinc-900/50 backdrop-blur-2xl border border-white/5 rounded-2xl shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(0,0,0,0.4)]
surfaces.headers: sticky top-0 z-50 bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-white/10 saturate-150

buttons.primary: bg-zinc-50 text-zinc-950 hover:bg-zinc-200 transition-colors rounded-full px-6 py-2.5 font-medium
buttons.accent: bg-[#007AFF] text-white hover:bg-blue-500 shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(0,122,255,0.3)] transition-all rounded-full px-6 py-2.5 font-medium
buttons.ghost: text-zinc-400 hover:text-zinc-50 hover:bg-white/5 rounded-full px-4 py-2 transition-colors

components_and_interactions.forms: Shadcn based. Inputs: bg-zinc-950/50 border-white/10 focus:border-[#007AFF] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#007AFF] text-white rounded-xl.
components_and_interactions.motion: Use framer-motion. Subtle scale (0.98 on tap), smooth opacity/y-axis reveals on scroll.
components_and_interactions.testing: CRITICAL: All interactive elements must have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='join-session-btn').

global_collaboration_map.style: Dark background (rgba(0,0,0,0)), globe image in dark/monochrome tones, points/arcs in electric blue (#007AFF) and gold (#F59E0B). Interactive on hover.

creative_passport.style: A vertical timeline mixed with a Notion-style verified log. Use 'Tracing Beam' border effect on the side of the timeline. Badges in Gold/Amber for 'Verified Institution' or 'Industry Label'.
creative_passport.typography: Heavy use of JetBrains Mono for dates and verification hashes.

shared_sessions.style: Live video tiles should have 1px solid border-white/10. Floating toolbar at the bottom (Glassmorphism). AI Assistant sidebar in a distinct darker panel (bg-black).

icons.style: Stroke width 1.5, text-zinc-400, hover to text-white.

hero_background.description: Abstract dark glass curves for the marketing hero background to give a premium OS feel.

shared_studios_cover.description: Dark music production mixer for the Shared Studios preview card.
shared_studios_cover.usage: Use inside bento grid cards with object-cover and a dark gradient bottom overlay.

creators_community.description: Creators collaborating / band playing, for the community/sessions section.
creators_community.usage: Use as a background for 'Active Collaborations' with heavy blur or dark tint.

logo_placeholder_1.usage: Use in 'Trusted By' or 'Institutions' marquee. MUST be styled with css filter: grayscale(100%) invert(100%) brightness(200%) to match dark theme.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install 'lucide-react' for icons, 'framer-motion' for animations, and 'react-globe.gl' for the world map.
Ensure all Shadcn components are built manually with pure HTML/Tailwind if standard components feel too rigid, but use Shadcn's radix-ui logic for complex interactions (Dialog, Select).
Global layout must be strictly dark mode. Do not implement a light mode toggle.
Ensure the hero section highlights the ANCRSync™ typography powerfully using Cabinet Grotesk.
Do NOT use placeholder text or dummy image URLs (like via.placeholder). Use only the URLs provided in this JSON.
All buttons, inputs, and clickable cards MUST have data-testid attributes.
For the globe map visualization, make sure the wrapper has a fixed height or min-height so the canvas renders properly.
